summary: Source Workbench System/Data selected-task cancellation uses verified collection-source admission and a shared current/selected cancellation receipt decoder. Invalid, wrong-ID and non-cancelled receipts do not confirm or start read recovery. Confirmed cancellation survives a failed history read. The selected cancellation shares the administrative parent write reservation through read recovery with task/result Save/Delete; duplicates and conflicts are not replayed. Accepted-intent feedback and effective endpoint/auth scope prevent late messages or reads from transferring to another backend. Historical cancellation never takes ownership of the live calculation merely by matching its ID. Pure frontend and mocked Chromium controls verify this bounded source-client behavior, not backend authorization, cross-client locking, unified current-job cancellation flights, signed provenance, continuous authority-history proof, installed WebView, remote, power-loss or scientific qualification. No snapshot, backup, write replay, production Node dependency or operational-grade promotion is introduced.

required_text: retained history cannot authorize cancellation on another backend
a historical record does not own the live job
an unread catalog is retained rather than fabricated as terminal
old confirmation cannot start a read on backend B
1,446 tests with zero failures or skips
